name: Nachrodt-Wiblingwerde (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nachrodt-Wiblingwerde (a rose on yellow above a chequy bar and blue waves).
history: Municipal flag of Nachrodt-Wiblingwerde; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Nachrodt-Wiblingwerde arms — rose, chequy bar and waves
